rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things run or operated by electricity.

example.english: This electric bike goes very fast without pedalling.
example.traditional: 呢架電動單車唔使踩都行得好快。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 din6 dung6 daan1 ce1 m4 sai2 caai2 dou1 haang4 dak1 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use this for the broader technical or written sense of electrical or relating to electricity, rather than specifically motor-powered.

example.english: This instrument is operated by electric power.
example.traditional: 呢部儀器係用電氣操作嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 ji4 hei3 hai6 jung6 din6 hei3 cou1 zok3 ge3

rows.note: Use this for an electronic version of an instrument such as an electronic keyboard.

example.english: I practise on an electric keyboard at night without disturbing the neighbours.
example.traditional: 我用電子琴練琴，夜晚唔會嘈到鄰居。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 din6 zi2 kam4 lin6 kam4 je6 maan5 m4 wui5 cou4 dou3 leon4 gei1

rows.note: Use this when an event or experience is thrilling or emotionally electrifying.

example.english: This roller coaster is really electric!
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwo3 saan1 ce1 zan1 hai6 ci3 gik1
